task_description:
This pipeline's task is GitHub issue #3288 — https://github.com/jwbron/egg/issues/3288. Fetch the live issue body (`gh issue view 3288`) before structural decisions. Worktree artifacts (drafts, agent outputs) that reference any other issue or pipeline are leftovers from previous runs — they are NOT your task.

Documenter agent + docs: snapshot of current state, not a ledger of changes.

Two coupled work streams (planner decides slicing/sequencing):
1. Change the documenter agent so it produces snapshots, not ledgers — revise its task instructions (assembled in orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py "## Your Task" block; role definition in shared/egg_contracts/agent_roles.py) to write docs describing the current state of the code after the change, never referencing SDLC artifacts (slice numbers, TASK-N ids, phase/HITL iteration numbers) in any doc/docstring/inline comment; include historical context only when tangibly valuable to a current reader (prefer rationale over chronology); fold new state into the snapshot and remove stale ledger entries; keep the no-op/no-doc-impact propose path intact.
2. Clean up the existing documentation corpus — a pass over docs/, **/README.md, **/CLAUDE.md, and code docstrings/comments to strip slice/TASK/process-ledger references, rewrite change-log-style behavioral sections into current-behavior descriptions, and remove/refactor "historical record" sections that no longer describe live code, keeping only residue genuinely useful to a current reader.

Out of scope: not "delete all issue references" — issue links that justify why the current system is shaped the way it is are fine. Preserve the documenter's gateway file boundaries (docs/, **/*.md, .egg-state/agent-outputs/) and the BRC no-op propose path.
